title: Bamboo fungus cap carbon quantum dot and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bamboo fungus cap carbon quantum dot and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nano-luminescence material preparation. The carbon quantum dot isprepared by taking a bamboo fungus cap as a carbon source and by adopting a hydrothermal method, the diameter of the carbon quantum dot is 2+/-0.5 nm, and the fluorescence emission peak is 440-505 nm.The carbon quantum dot has a very strong inhibition effect on ralstonia solanacearum and carpetweed xanthomonas. According to the carbon quantum dot and the preparation method thereof, biological resources are effectively utilized, and in addition, a foundation is laid for control of bacterial diseases.
